findings.detail: Cross-account isolation for notifications, ticket ledger, recommendations, follows, profiles, applications and other user-owned resources is not established by source inspection alone.
findings.action: Add two-account Worker/D1 tests proving every read, update, delete, export and background job is scoped to the authenticated owner.

findings.detail: Administrator account PATCH now validates an explicit field allowlist, rejects empty or unknown fields, protects the last active administrator, and batches the update with a conditional audit row. Static and local SQLite transaction checks are present; live D1 concurrency remains unverified.
findings.action: Run isolated Cloudflare D1 concurrency and audit-failure tests before security sign-off.

findings.detail: Taxonomy submission attribution is now derived from the verified session, client-supplied creator identity is ignored, and submissions are IP-rate-limited. Regression checks cover the source invariants; live abuse/rate-limit behavior remains unverified.
findings.action: Run browser/Worker tests for anonymous and authenticated submissions, spoof attempts, and rate-limit behavior.

findings.detail: Public comment reads and authenticated comment writes now require the parent novel to be published and rights eligible; reply parents must also be visible and belong to the same novel. Isolated D1 behavior tests remain outstanding.
findings.action: Run isolated D1 tests for missing, draft, rights-ineligible and eligible parent novels and cross-novel reply attempts.

findings.detail: Unsafe browser-originated API requests now reject mismatched Origin headers and Sec-Fetch-Site=cross-site before schema bootstrap and session lookup. SameSite=Lax remains defense-in-depth; browser edge cases are not yet runtime-tested.
findings.action: Add browser tests for same-origin POST, cross-origin form POST, missing Origin and Fetch Metadata edge cases; verify signed webhook exceptions separately.

findings.detail: The public vote-board response no longer joins users or returns requester usernames; it exposes request metadata and aggregate vote counts. Static response-shape regression coverage is present.
findings.action: Review whether request URLs and source hosts are appropriate public fields and add abuse controls if needed.

findings.detail: Story Bible and chapter-generation handlers now require strict project ownership even for administrators, preventing privileged cross-owner generation and misattributed jobs. Static ownership regression coverage is present; two-account runtime proof remains outstanding.
findings.action: Add two-account Worker tests for admin and other-author access to creator-owned projects, generation jobs and owner history.

findings.detail: Admin report status updates now check affected-row counts, return an error for missing or unchanged targets, and emit an audit event containing report id and resulting status. D1 audit persistence/failure behavior remains to be exercised.
findings.action: Verify audit persistence and failure behavior against isolated Cloudflare D1.

findings.detail: The duplicate legacy POST /api/rating handler has been removed. The remaining handler accepts only safe whole-number ratings from 1 to 10 and retains published/rights-eligible novel checks. The runtime ratings CHECK constraint, catalog minimum-rating cap, public rating formatter, library/author displays, reader ten-choice control and responsive ten-column layout have been updated. Fresh-install and existing-install migration 0034/0035 fixtures, migration sequence validation and CI integrity checks are wired; the latest full CI result remains pending.
findings.action: Require the full source-validation workflow to pass the 35-migration fresh replay, foreign_key_check, integrity_check, rating migration fixture, public/served asset parity and Worker build. Do not apply the rating migration to production D1 until the remote migration ledger and recoverable backup are verified.

findings.detail: Donation approval uses a pending-only transition, conditional balance credit and ledger insertion in a D1 batch. Local SQLite integration tests cover successful approval, replay prevention and ledger-failure rollback; live D1 concurrency is not proven.
findings.action: Run isolated Cloudflare D1 concurrency tests for duplicate approvals and verify rollback and ledger invariants before production use.

findings.detail: Explicit GET-only guards now return 405 for the audited read-only endpoints, including /api/me, /api/config, /api/genres, /api/tags, /api/public-authors, /api/sources and OmniPortal read routes. Route-method inventory validation is included in CI; the full API surface still needs continued review.
findings.action: Keep the method matrix synchronized with dispatcher changes and add Allow headers plus tests where required by the route contract.

findings.detail: Owner scoping is present on several author collections and job-history reads, but cross-account enforcement for all AI project, chapter job and related resource operations is not proven by static source review.
findings.action: Add two-account tests for project detail, Story Bible, chapter generation, job status/history, cancellation, export and all project mutations.

findings.detail: Password recovery and email ownership verification now use rate-limited routes, purpose-bound token digests, email snapshots, one-time consumption IDs, generic recovery responses, provider fail-closed behavior, and session revocation on password reset. Local SQLite and helper tests cover key invariants; deployed Worker and live D1 runtime behavior remain unverified.
findings.action: Add isolated Worker/D1 integration tests for enumeration resistance, concurrent token consumption, email changes, delivery failure, session revocation, and rollback before security sign-off.
